w:r.w:t: Sphere Global – Customized Damage Prevention Solution for GM

This proposal presents a comprehensive, customized solution developed by Sphere Global to address General Motors’ need for enhanced damage prevention, inspection, and data visibility across its vehicle logistics ecosystem. The proposed solution leverages Sphere’s advanced

of AI-driven, vision-based inspection technologies — specifically tailored to meet GM’s operational workflows at key handoff points such as production exit, dispatch yards, release gates, and dealerships.
Sphere Global has extensive experience building and deploying intelligent inspection systems for global

, logistics providers, and port operators. The PRISM solution is designed to be modular, scalable, and seamlessly integrable into GM’s existing systems and infrastructure. With this deployment, GM will gain near real-time inspection data, high-resolution vehicle imagery, automated damage detection, and a centralized portal for holistic oversight and auditing — significantly reducing claims, disputes, and downstream operational friction.
